name: verter
description: Vue compiler and Language Server Protocol implementation
author: pikax

scripts.test:lsp:neutral: cargo build -p verter_lsp -p verter_relay_shim && pnpm --filter @verter/language-shared build && pnpm --filter @verter/typescript-plugin build && pnpm --filter @verter/dx-harness test:editor-neutral-lsp
scripts.test:scripts: vitest run scripts/sccache-env.test.mjs && vitest run scripts/wasm-opt-cache.test.mjs && node --test scripts/lib/publish-set.spec.mjs && node --test scripts/lib/crate-graph.spec.mjs && node --test scripts/editor-contracts/plenary-outcome-guard.test.mjs && node --test scripts/validate-performance-gates.test.mjs && node --test scripts/probe-bundler-route-isolation.test.mjs && node --test scripts/affected-tests.test.mjs && node --test scripts/gate-telemetry-selftest.mjs && node --test scripts/bf2-ci-lane-selftest.mjs && node --test scripts/compiler-ci-lane-selftest.mjs && node --test scripts/provider-ci-lane-selftest.mjs && node --test scripts/check-ci-aggregate.test.mjs
scripts.dist: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:lsp:release && pnpm --filter @verter/wasm build && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.dist:cached: node scripts/run-cached.mjs -- "pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:lsp:release && pnpm --filter @verter/wasm build && pnpm run build:ts"
scripts.build: node scripts/build-host.mjs --profile artifact-dev && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:cached: node scripts/run-cached.mjs -- node scripts/build-host.mjs --profile artifact-dev && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:lapce: rustup target add wasm32-wasip1 && cargo build --manifest-path extensions/lapce/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && npx shx mkdir -p extensions/lapce/bin && npx shx cp extensions/lapce/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/verter_lapce.wasm extensions/lapce/bin/verter-lapce.wasm
scripts.build:zed: rustup target add wasm32-wasip2 && cargo build --manifest-path extensions/zed/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-wasip2 --release && npx shx mkdir -p extensions/zed/bin && npx shx cp extensions/zed/target/wasm32-wasip2/release/verter_zed.wasm extensions/zed/bin/verter-zed.wasm
scripts.dev-extension: pnpm run build:lsp && pnpm --filter @verter/language-shared --filter verter-vscode --filter @verter/typescript-plugin watch
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec npx shx rm -rf .turbo dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx shx rm -rf .turbo dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
